newsitem.title: UK: Vega sees profits similar to last year.
newsitem.headline: Vega sees profits similar to last year.

text.p: Vega Group Plc said on Monday that pre-tax profits for 1996/97 were likely to be similar to those of last year.
For the year to April 30, 1996 the software and systems engineering firm made pre-tax profits of 3.45 million stg.
It said that despite an order book "substantially" ahead of this time last year a slower than expected start to the year and the "growing strength" of the pound would rein in profits.

Vega also announced it was buying software-based training company CBL Technology Ltd for an undisclosed sum. CBL made pre-tax profits of 404,000 stg on a turnover of 1.7 million stg for the year to march 31, 1996.
It said that it expects the purchase to enhance earnings from the outset.
